name: table
title: Table
description: Rows of data on hairlines, with sortable headings and aligned figures.
use: Many things compared by the same properties, column by column. It has no surface of its own: put it in a sheet or a card, and in a scroll area when it can be wider than its column.

instead.when: It describes one thing with many properties, so the headings would not repeat
Each row is a thing with media, a name and something at its end, and nothing is compared by column

classes.name: table
classes.description: The table: a native table or a grid of roles

classes.name: table-heading
classes.description: A column heading: a quiet caption on a firmer rule than the rows

classes.name: table-cell
classes.description: A start-aligned data cell or row header. A native scope=row/rowgroup or role=rowheader uses the theme’s control weight instead of browser bold

classes.name: table-primary
classes.description: The identifying cell of a row, in strong ink

classes.name: table-numeric
classes.description: Right-aligned tabular figures, on a heading or a cell

classes.name: table-compact
classes.description: Denser rows, for long lists read by scanning

classes.name: table-interactive
classes.description: Rows that hold cells answer the pointer and show a focus ring

classes.name: table-sticky
classes.description: Headings stay in view while the rows scroll under them

states.name: sorted ascending
states.description: Strong ink and a chevron that points up

states.name: sorted descending
states.description: Strong ink and a chevron that points down

states.name: selected
states.description: The row takes a chip tone; say it with the row's checkbox as well

properties.name: --table-padding-x
properties.description: Inline padding of headings and cells; .75rem in a compact table

properties.name: --table-padding-y
properties.description: Block padding of cells; .4375rem in a compact table
